exact_missing_items: Orchestrator must remain tab-first (not widget-first) and expose exactly 6 canonical tabs: Progress, Seams, Node Graph, Evidence, History, Ledger
Seams tab must show Feature Seams at the top level, Work Packages at the second level, and individual nodes on drill-in
Evidence tab must have two distinct panes: an Evidence pane (verdicts/receipts) and an Artifacts pane (screenshots/recordings/diffs)
History tab = chronological story view; Ledger tab = structured durable record inspection; these are distinct purposes and must not be merged
Side inspectors must remain summary/action-light; dense objects (attempt handoff, review records, graph patch requests, etc.) must open full-record views, not be inlined in inspectors
Weak Integration must not be merely a badge; it must show grouped concerns under specific headings: Wiring, Workflow, State, GUI, Design
Operator event visibility must be tiered: history-only / badge-worthy / attention-card-worthy / chat-thread action-required — each event family must declare its tier
Tab badges must be sparse and purposeful; the Progress tab badge must count only meaningful attention/action-required items, not routine events
Condition-aging defaults: normal resolved conditions clear in ~15 minutes; major resolved conditions persist until dismissed or up to 24 hours
Under degraded projections, the UI must fall back to Ledger and direct record views; fallback path must be defined and surfaced to the user
gap_candidates.blocking_reason: Coverage row indicates incomplete or missing canon alignment for concrete target.
